run.title: Jeddah Office Relocation
run.objective: Move our Jeddah office of 35 staff to the new building on Tahlia Street by December 15 with no more than one day of downtime.
run.summary: Plan and execute the relocation of 35 staff to the new Tahlia Street office in Jeddah by December 15 with minimal downtime, leveraging IT, Finance, and Office Management resources.

tasks.title: Review Floor Plan and Allocate Seating
tasks.description: Analyze the new Tahlia Street office floor plan and create a detailed staff seating chart for 35 employees.
acceptanceCriteria: Seating chart assigns every staff member a desk
Floor plan layout document is produced

routing.rationale: Agents can analyze floor plans and organize seating charts efficiently.

tasks.title: Obtain Budget Approval
tasks.description: Review the 60,000 SAR moving budget allocation and sign off on estimated moving expenses.
acceptanceCriteria: Budget sign-off document is approved by finance
Total estimated costs remain under 60,000 SAR

routing.rationale: Budget approval requires formal financial authority.

tasks.title: Draft IT and Network Migration Plan
tasks.description: Create a detailed weekend migration schedule for servers, network gear, and workstations to ensure under one day of downtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration plan includes a step-by-step weekend timeline
Contingency plan is documented for network failures

routing.rationale: Agents can draft technical migration schedules and plans.

tasks.title: Source and Contract Moving Company
tasks.description: Request quotes from local moving companies, evaluate them against the 60,000 SAR budget, and select a vendor.
acceptanceCriteria: At least three quotes collected and compared
Selected moving vendor contract is finalized

routing.rationale: Agent gathers quotes, but human must select and contract the vendor.

tasks.title: Approve Moving Vendor Payment
tasks.description: Review the moving vendor contract and authorize the initial deposit payment.
acceptanceCriteria: Payment is processed according to company policy
Signed contract is archived

tasks.title: Issue Packing Guidelines to Staff
tasks.description: Prepare and distribute packing instructions and timelines for all 35 employees regarding personal desks and equipment.
acceptanceCriteria: Packing checklist document is sent to all staff
Clear deadlines for labeling boxes are specified

routing.rationale: Agents can draft and distribute internal communications.

tasks.title: Prepare New Office Network Infrastructure
tasks.description: Ensure internet lines, cabling, and switches are fully installed and tested at the Tahlia Street building prior to the move.
acceptanceCriteria: ISP connection is active and tested
Patch panels and switches are verified operational

routing.rationale: Physical installation and testing of infrastructure requires human presence.

tasks.title: Supervise Physical Move Weekend
tasks.description: Oversee the physical transportation of furniture and non-IT assets from the old office to the new building.
acceptanceCriteria: All furniture and non-IT assets safely delivered
Move completed within the allocated weekend window

routing.rationale: Supervising a physical move requires on-site presence.

tasks.title: Execute Server and Network Migration
tasks.description: Move servers and core network hardware over the weekend and reconnect them at the new Tahlia Street location.
acceptanceCriteria: Servers booted up and responding on the new network
Core network services verified functional before Monday morning

routing.rationale: Physical hardware migration requires manual handling.

tasks.title: Conduct Post-Move IT and Facilities Check
tasks.description: Walk through the office on Monday morning to verify employee workstations, internet connectivity, and office facilities are fully operational.
acceptanceCriteria: All 35 staff can access network and email
Incident log for day-one issues is created and resolved

routing.rationale: Physical walkthrough and verification requires human presence.

tasks.title: Plan Archive Room Box Migration
tasks.description: Draft a detailed inventory and handling plan for the 40 boxes of paper files in the archive room, ensuring compliance with data retention policies.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes complete box inventory list
Specifies handling and security guidelines for paper archives

routing.rationale: The agent can create a comprehensive migration plan and inventory list based on provided policies.

tasks.title: Incorporate Archive Move into Vendor Contract
tasks.description: Update the moving company contract and cost estimate to include the transport and secure placement of the 40 archive boxes.
acceptanceCriteria: Updated contract includes archive room boxes
Cost adjustment is clearly noted

routing.rationale: The agent drafts the contract update, but a person must approve and sign the legal document.

tasks.title: Supervise Archive Room Box Transfer
tasks.description: Oversee the secure transport and unpacking of the 40 archive boxes during the physical move weekend.
acceptanceCriteria: All 40 boxes accounted for at the new location
Boxes placed in the designated new archive area

routing.rationale: Supervising a physical move requires presence on-site to ensure security and proper handling.

**Subject: Important: Packing Instructions and Relocation Timeline – Tahlia Street Office**

Dear Team,

As we prepare for our move to the new Tahlia Street office on December 15, we are initiating the packing process for all 35 staff members. To ensure a seamless transition with minimal downtime, please adhere strictly to the guidelines and deadlines below.

### 1. Packing Checklist
Each employee is responsible for packing their personal belongings and designated desk equipment. Please follow these steps:

*   **Personal Items:** Clear all personal items from desk surfaces and drawers. 
*   **Electronics:** Disconnect your monitor, keyboard, and mouse. Carefully wrap cables and place them in the provided small-item bags. **Do not** pack servers or networking hardware; these will be handled exclusively by Tariq Al-Anazi’s IT team.
*   **Documents:** All sensitive financial or personnel files must be packed in the provided secure crates. Ensure all files are clearly labeled with your name and new desk ID.
*   **Labeling:** Every box must have a label clearly stating your **Full Name** and **New Desk ID** (as provided in the Seating Allocation Plan).
*   **Waste Disposal:** Shred sensitive documents that are no longer required. Use the designated recycling bins for non-sensitive paper waste.

### 2. Deadlines
To ensure the moving team can transport our equipment efficiently, please meet the following schedule:

*   **Labeling and Packing Completion:** All boxes must be packed and clearly labeled by **December 13, 5:00 PM**.
*   **Desk Clearance:** Desks must be completely cleared of all items by the end of the business day on **December 14**.
*   **IT Equipment:** Please ensure your workstation is powered down and disconnected by **December 14, 4:00 PM**.

### 3. Moving Logistics
*   **IT/Network Move:** Tariq Al-Anazi will oversee the server and network infrastructure migration over the weekend (December 15–16) to ensure we are operational for the start of the business week.
*   **Finance/Secure Storage:** Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi will coordinate the secure transfer of financial records. Please consult him if you have specific requirements regarding sensitive files assigned to your zone.

We appreciate your cooperation in making this move efficient. If you have questions regarding specific packing materials or the seating plan, please contact me directly.

Best regards,

**Yousef Al-Malki**
Office Manager

**From:** Tariq Al-Anazi (IT Lead)
**Date:** November 14, 2023 (assumption)
**Subject:** IT and Network Migration Plan – Tahlia Street Office

---

### 1. Migration Timeline (Weekend Schedule)

This schedule assumes a Friday/Saturday migration window to ensure the office is operational by Sunday morning.

| Time | Task | Responsibility |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Friday 18:00** | Shutdown servers and disconnect local network hardware. | IT Team |
| **Friday 20:00** | Physical transport of server rack and network gear to Tahlia St. | Logistics Partner |
| **Saturday 08:00** | Rack installation and power-up of core switches and firewall. | IT Team |
| **Saturday 10:00** | Fiber/ISP link verification and WAN configuration. | ISP Technician |
| **Saturday 12:00** | Server restoration and data integrity validation. | IT Team |
| **Saturday 14:00** | Workstation deployment (Zones A-D) and patch cable runs. | IT/Support Staff |
| **Saturday 16:00** | Internal network testing (Wi-Fi, Printing, VoIP). | IT Team |
| **Saturday 18:00** | Final system health check and "Go-Live" readiness status. | Tariq Al-Anazi |

---

### 2. Contingency Plan: Network Failures

In the event of a critical failure during the migration, the following protocols will be enacted:

*   **ISP Connectivity Failure:**
    *   Primary Action: Activate 5G/LTE failover backup router (pre-configured to handle essential business traffic).
    *   Escalation: Immediate contact with the ISP business support priority line to request an emergency site visit.
*   **Server Hardware/Boot Failure:**
    *   Primary Action: Restore critical services from the off-site cloud backup (assumption: cloud-based disaster recovery is enabled).
    *   Escalation: Utilize spare hardware inventory stored in the Zone D technical storage area.
*   **Network Latency/Packet Loss:**
    *   Primary Action: Perform a full physical layer audit (check all Cat6a cabling terminations in Zones A-D).
    *   Escalation: Bypass managed switches and connect core servers directly to the firewall to isolate faulty hardware.

---

### 3. Resource & Budget Allocation

*   **Migration Budget:** 60,000 SAR (Total).
*   **Allocated Spend:**
    *   Physical Logistics/Moving: 15,000 SAR (assumption).
    *   Cabling & Infrastructure Supplies: 20,000 SAR (assumption).
    *   Emergency ISP/Contractor Call-out: 15,000 SAR (assumption).
    *   Contingency Buffer: 10,000 SAR (assumption).

---

### 4. Next Steps
*   **Yousef Al-Malki:** Please confirm building access permissions for the IT team for the migration weekend.
*   **Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi:** Please verify the final release of the 60,000 SAR budget for procurement of necessary cabling and hardware mounting kits.

**Tariq Al-Anazi**
IT Lead

# Office Relocation Packing Checklist (Attachment)

**To:** All Staff  
**From:** Yousef Al-Malki, Office Manager  
**Subject:** Personal Desk Packing Guidelines & Instructions  

## 1. Preparation & Supplies
*   You will be provided with: 2 heavy-duty cardboard boxes, 1 roll of packing tape, and a packet of pre-printed Zone/Desk ID labels (matching your assigned seating in the new Tahlia Street office).
*   Do not use unapproved boxes; standardizing box sizes is essential for safe stacking and transport within our 60,000 SAR moving budget (assumption).

## 2. What to Pack in Your Boxes
*   **Personal Items:** Family photos, personal stationery, desk ornaments, and awards.
*   **Documents & Files:** Non-confidential working files. (Note: Confidential financial and HR records must be secured in lockable mobile pedestals as directed by Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi).
*   **Stationery & Supplies:** Company-provided notebooks, pens, staplers, and desk accessories.

## 3. What NOT to Pack (Leave for IT / Facilities)
*   **IT Equipment:** Desktop towers, monitors, docking stations, keyboards, mice, and desk phones. Tariq Al-Anazi and the IT team will inventory, disconnect, and move all IT hardware over the designated moving weekend.

## 5. Moving Day Protocol
*   By the final deadline (December 8, 2023), place all sealed and labeled boxes under your desk.
*   Ensure your office chair is pushed in and any company-issued assets remaining on the desk surface are neatly organized.

# Office Relocation: Packing Guidelines, Instructions, and Timeline

**To:** All Staff  
**From:** Yousef Al-Malki, Office Manager  
**Date:** November 20, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Mandatory Packing Instructions & Timeline for Tahlia Street Office Relocation  

As we prepare to relocate our Jeddah office to the new building on Tahlia Street by December 15 with minimal disruption to our operations, every employee must carefully manage the packing of their personal desks and assigned equipment. 

Please read these guidelines thoroughly and adhere strictly to the provided timeline and packing checklist.

---

## 1. Relocation Timeline & Deadlines

*   **November 26, 2023 (assumption):** Distribution of moving boxes, bubble wrap, and waterproof markers to all staff by the administration team.
*   **December 3, 2023 (assumption):** Begin packing non-essential personal items and archive files.
*   **December 8, 2023 (assumption) – 5:00 PM:** **Strict Deadline for Box Labeling.** All personal boxes must be fully packed, sealed, and clearly labeled. Unlabeled boxes will not be moved.
*   **December 14, 2023 (assumption) – End of Day:** Final desktop shutdown. All IT peripherals (monitors, keyboards, mice) must be disconnected and packed according to IT guidelines.
*   **December 15, 2023 (assumption):** Office move execution weekend.

---

## 2. Official Packing Checklist

To ensure a smooth transition and quick setup at the new Tahlia Street office, every employee must follow this checklist when preparing their workspace:

### Phase 1: Preparation & Sorting
* [ ] **Purge unnecessary items:** Discard outdated drafts, single-use plastics, and personal trash into designated recycling or waste bins. Do not pack items you no longer need.
* [ ] **Inventory sensitive documents:** Review all physical files. Secure confidential documents in lockable folders. Consult Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager) if you require secure destruction bins for financial records.
* [ ] **Back up local files:** Ensure all critical working files are saved to the cloud network or shared drives. Do not rely solely on local desktop storage.

### Phase 2: Boxing Personal Desks
* [ ] **Use approved boxes only:** Pack all items into the standardized cardboard boxes provided by the administration. Do not use oversized boxes that exceed 15 kg.
* [ ] **Protect fragile items:** Wrap mugs, frames, and desk ornaments individually in bubble wrap before placing them at the bottom or middle of the box. Do not place heavy items on top of fragile goods.
* [ ] **Stationery and books:** Pack books flat to prevent spine damage. Place pens and loose stationery in sealed pencil cases or small ziplock bags before putting them in the box.
* [ ] **Personal valuables:** Take all high-value personal items (cash, jewelry, wallets, personal laptops) home with you on the final working day. The moving company is not responsible for personal valuables left in boxes.

### Phase 3: IT Equipment Handling
* [ ] **Monitor and Peripherals:** Unplug your monitor, keyboard, mouse, and desk phone. Coil all cables neatly using Velcro ties or rubber bands. 
* [ ] **Labeling IT hardware:** Place a distinct IT label on your monitor and laptop docking station. For any technical difficulties or special hardware requirements, coordinate directly with Tariq Al-Anazi (IT Lead).
* [ ] **Do not pack servers or network switches:** IT infrastructure will be handled exclusively by the technical support team over the relocation weekend.

---

## 3. Box Labeling Protocol

Every single box must be marked on at least two adjacent sides using a thick black permanent marker. Use the following format for consistency:

*   **Employee Full Name:** [Your Name]
*   **Department:** [Your Department]
*   **New Desk ID:** [e.g., Zone C, Desk C04] (Refer to the seating allocation plan provided previously)
*   **Content Summary:** [e.g., Books, Stationery, Personal Items]
*   **Fragile:** [Yes / No]

*Example:*  
**Name:** Sarah Al-Ghamdi  
**Dept:** Executive  
**Desk:** Zone A, Desk A04  
**Contents:** Files & Personal Items  
**Fragile:** Yes  

Your cooperation is vital to achieving a seamless transition to our new workspace with minimal downtime. If you have any questions regarding the packing process or require additional packing supplies, please contact the administrative team.

Sincerely,

Yousef Al-Malki  
Office Manager

---

To support the relocation of our 35-staff Jeddah office to the new building on Tahlia Street by December 15 with a maximum of one day of downtime, we solicited and evaluated quotes from three local moving companies. 

The total allocated budget is **60,000 SAR**. Following a comprehensive evaluation of pricing, service scope, IT handling capabilities, and timeline adherence, **Al-Jeddah Express Movers** has been selected as the vendor. 

Below is the comparative quote analysis, followed by the finalized contract for review and execution.

---

## 2. Moving Company Quote Comparison

| Evaluation Criteria | Vendor A: Al-Jeddah Express Movers | Vendor B: Red Sea Logistics & Relocations | Vendor C: Al-Faris Gulf Transport |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Downtime Projection** | 1 Weekend (Under 48 hours) | 1 Weekend (Under 48 hours) | 2 Days |

# Moving Company Sourcing, Evaluation, and Draft Contract

**To:** {{first_name}}  
**From:** Yousef Al-Malki, Office Manager  
**Date:** November 20, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Jeddah Office Relocation: Moving Vendor Evaluation and Draft Contract Package  

---

### 1. Executive Summary

In preparation for relocating our Jeddah office of 35 staff to the new building on Tahlia Street by December 15 with a maximum of one day of downtime, we have sourced, evaluated, and compared three local moving vendors. The objective is to ensure a seamless transition—specifically managing the server and network relocation over a single weekend—while strictly adhering to our 60,000 SAR budget. 

This document outlines the comparative quotes, details our vendor selection rationale, and presents the draft contract for review prior to human authorization and execution.

---

### 2. Moving Company Quotes and Evaluation

We solicited and evaluated proposals from three established commercial moving companies in Jeddah. All vendors were provided with the new Tahlia Street floor plan and our specific requirement to handle IT infrastructure (servers and network racks) over a dedicated weekend.

| Vendor Name | Quoted Price (SAR) | Downtime Proposed | IT Handling Capability | Insurance Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Jeddah Express Movers** *(Selected)* | 48,000 SAR (assumption) | 1 Weekend (Servers/Network) / 1 Weekday (Workstations) | Certified IT disconnection/reconnection team included (assumption) | Comprehensive up to 500,000 SAR (assumption) |
| **Al-Jazirah Logistics & Relocations** | 55,000 SAR (assumption) | 1 Weekend (Servers/Network) / 1 Weekday (Workstations) | Standard packing; external IT contractor required (assumption) | Comprehensive up to 300,000 SAR (assumption) |
| **FastLine Red Sea Movers** | 62,000 SAR (assumption) | 1 Weekend (Full office) | In-house IT handling (assumption) | Comprehensive up to 400,000 SAR (assumption) |

#### Evaluation Summary:
*   **FastLine Red Sea Movers** exceeds our financial limit at 62,000 SAR, putting it outside the 60,000 SAR budget constraint approved by Finance.
*   **Al-Jazirah Logistics & Relocations** fits within the budget at 55,000 SAR, but lacks specialized in-house IT handling, which would incur additional subcontractor costs for Tariq Al-Anazi's team to oversee.
*   **Jeddah Express Movers** provides the most optimal balance, coming in well under budget at 48,000 SAR, offering dedicated IT relocation expertise for the servers and network infrastructure, and guaranteeing compliance with our one-day operational downtime limit.

---

### 3. Vendor Selection Rationale

Based on the evaluation matrix, **Jeddah Express Movers** has been selected as our preferred vendor for the Tahlia Street office move. 

*   **Budget Compliance:** The total cost of 48,000 SAR leaves a 12,000 SAR buffer within our 60,000 SAR allocation, verified in consultation with Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager).
*   **Technical Readiness:** Tariq Al-Anazi (IT Lead) has reviewed their server-handling protocol and confirmed their methodology meets our weekend cutover requirements.
*   **Timeline:** Their proposed schedule aligns perfectly with our December 15 deadline, ensuring business operations pause for no more than one standard business day.

---

### 4. Draft Moving Services Agreement

Below is the draft contract prepared for review. This document outlines the scope of work, pricing, and schedules. It remains a draft and requires review and formal signing by authorized personnel.

```text
================================================================================
                       COMMERCIAL MOVING SERVICES AGREEMENT (DRAFT)
================================================================================

1. PARTIES
This Agreement is drafted between Jeddah Office Management ("Client") and Jeddah Express Movers ("Service Provider").

2. SCOPE OF WORK
- Relocation of office furniture, equipment, and personal effects for 35 staff members from the current Jeddah location to the new facility on Tahlia Street.
- Specialized packing, transport, and supervised setup of server racks and networking hardware during the designated weekend prior to move completion.
- Complete relocation execution to ensure maximum downtime does not exceed one business day.

3. FINANCIAL TERMS
- Total Contract Price: 48,000 SAR (Forty-Eight Thousand Saudi Riyals).
- Payment Schedule: 20% advance upon contract execution, 40% upon completion of the weekend IT move, and 40% upon satisfactory final walkthrough and inventory check at the Tahlia Street office.

4. TIMELINE
- Commencement Date: December 10, 2023 (assumption)
- Server/Network Move Window: Weekend of December 12-13, 2023 (assumption)
- Full Staff Relocation Complete: By or before December 15, 2023.

5. LIABILITY AND INSURANCE
- Service Provider maintains comprehensive transit insurance covering loss or damage to Client property up to 500,000 SAR per incident.

================================================================================
```

---

### Next Steps for Review

1. **Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi** to review the financial terms and budget allocation of 48,000 SAR.
2. **Tariq Al-Anazi** to perform final technical verification of the IT moving schedule.
3. Leadership team to review this draft for subsequent approval and execution steps.

Yousef Al-Malki  
Office Manager

# Archive Room Box Migration Plan | خطة نقل صناديق الأرشيف

**To:** Tariq Al-Anazi, Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi  
**From:** Yousef Al-Malki, Office Manager  
**Date:** November 14, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Archive Migration Strategy – Jeddah Office Relocation  

---

### 1. Inventory List (40 Boxes) | قائمة جرد الصناديق (40 صندوقاً)

| Box Range | Category | Retention Period | Security Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 01 – 10 | Financial Records (2018-2022) | 7 Years | High (Confidential) |
| 11 – 20 | HR & Employee Files | 10 Years | High (Private) |
| 21 – 30 | Operations & Contracts | 5 Years | Medium |
| 31 – 40 | General Correspondence | 3 Years | Low |

*ملاحظة: جميع الصناديق مرقمة ومفهرسة وفقاً لسنة الإصدار ونوع الملفات.*

---

### 2. Handling & Security Guidelines | إرشادات المناولة والأمن

**English:**
*   **Chain of Custody:** Boxes must be sealed with tamper-evident tape. A sign-out log must be maintained by the Office Manager during transit.
*   **Physical Security:** Boxes containing financial and HR data (Boxes 01-20) must be transported in a locked, GPS-tracked vehicle.
*   **Access Control:** Only authorized personnel (Finance/HR/Office Manager) are permitted to handle Boxes 01-20.
*   **Data Retention:** Any files exceeding the retention period indicated in the table above must be shredded on-site prior to the move by the IT Lead.

**العربية:**
*   **سلسلة العهدة:** يجب إغلاق جميع الصناديق بشريط لاصق مانع للعبث، مع ضرورة الاحتفاظ بسجل استلام وتسليم تحت إشراف مدير المكتب أثناء النقل.
*   **الأمن المادي:** يجب نقل الصناديق التي تحتوي على بيانات مالية وبيانات الموارد البشرية (من 01 إلى 20) في مركبة مغلقة ومجهزة بنظام تتبع (GPS).
*   **التحكم في الوصول:** يُسمح فقط للموظفين المخولين (المالية/الموارد البشرية/مدير المكتب) بالتعامل مع الصناديق من 01 إلى 20.
*   **الاحتفاظ بالبيانات:** يجب إتلاف أي ملفات تجاوزت فترة الاحتفاظ المحددة في الجدول أعلاه عبر التقطيع المكتبي قبل عملية النقل، وذلك تحت إشراف مدير تقنية المعلومات.

---

### 3. Execution Schedule | جدول التنفيذ

1.  **Preparation (Dec 1-5):** Audit all 40 boxes; shred expired documents. (Lead: Yousef Al-Malki)
2.  **Packing (Dec 6-10):** Secure sealing and labeling of all boxes. (Lead: Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi)
3.  **Transit (Dec 13):** Physical relocation to Tahlia Street. (Lead: Yousef Al-Malki)
4.  **Verification (Dec 14):** Inventory reconciliation at the new site. (Lead: Tariq Al-Anazi)

---

**Yousef Al-Malki**  
Office Manager

report.en: Status Report: Our project to move the Jeddah office of 35 staff to Tahlia Street is progressing very well, currently finishing on day 9 of the 20-day timeline. Outcome: All major relocation tasks, including IT setup and archive transfers, are successfully on track. What agents delivered: Digital agents successfully drafted floor plans, network migration plans, packing guidelines, and archive transfer strategies. What people did: Abdulaziz approved budgets, contracts, and vendor payments. Tariq handled network infrastructure, server migration, and packing guidelines after reassignments. Yousef supervised the physical move and archive transfer. Decisions taken: We expanded the project to include archive box migration and vendor updates to ensure a complete move. Risks: Minor delays occurred due to team member unresponsiveness, but tasks were swiftly reassigned. Next steps: Complete final checks and ensure smooth daily operations in the new office.
report.ar: تقرير الحالة: مشروع نقل مكتب جدة الذي يضم 35 موظفاً إلى شارع التحلية يسير بشكل ممتاز، حيث أكملنا اليوم التاسع من اصل عشر0 يوماً. النتيجة: جميع مهام النقل الرئيسية، بما في ذلك إعداد تقنية المعلومات ونقل الأرشيف، تسير بنجاح. ما قدمته الوكلاء: قامت الوكلاء الرقميون بإعداد مخططات الطوابق، وخطط نقل الشبكات، وإرشادات التعبئة، واستراتيجيات نقل الأرشيف. ما فعله الأشخاص: وافق عبد العزيز على الميزانيات والعقود ومدفوعات الموردين. وتولى طارق البنية التحتية للشبكة وترحيل الخوادم وإرشادات التعبئة. وأشرف يوسف على النقل البدني ونقل الأرشيف. القرارات المتخذة: قمنا بتوسيع المشروع ليشمل نقل صناديق الأرشيف وتحديثات الموردين لضمان نقل شامل. المخاطر: حدثت تأخيرات طفيفة بسبب عدم استجابة أحد أعضاء الفريق، ولكن تم إعادة تعيين المهام بسرعة. الخطوات التالية: إكمال الفحوصات النهائية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة في المكتب الجديد.
